normalisation.note: SDK stores bare paths; oazapfts prepends the base at runtime, so forms already agreed

presence.reason: SDK is generated from the specification; NOT a replication of the Section 3.1 premise

secondary.reason: @immich/sdk is code-generated from the specification used as ground truth, so its precision measures the generator rather than the classifier

recurring_finding.note: on two of three applications roughly half the interface literally present is never recovered; extraction, not classification, is the larger loss and is undiagnosed

verdict: GENERALIZED - both thresholds met; secondary now +0.4 pts not -13.5

criterion.primary: repaired recall reaches >= 90% of the measured extraction ceiling
criterion.note: A ceiling-relative primary is the correct form: an absolute point-gain requirement would be imposed on a quantity bounded by a ceiling that differs per application.

artefact_scope: generated API client @immich/sdk 3.2.4, NOT a built web application client; no web bundle is published and no Docker was available

tier.definition: request-construction precision minus absent-evidence precision, assigned by classifier_rule.classify_endpoint over every relative-path record in the extraction
tier.bar: +20 points for the tier to be said to carry signal
tier.not_assessable_because: the artefact yields one false positive among 167 relative rows (the base path /api), against 177 of 424 on Jellyfin, so no tier has anything to discriminate and the spread is zero by construction

scope_conditions.reason: every path string in the artefact originates in the ground truth, so precision approaches 100% by construction and no tier has false positives to discriminate

client_artefact.note: generated API client library, not the built web application client
